<?php require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$out = '/wordpress/wp-content/plugins/ceypay-payment-gateway/SMOKE_RESULT.txt';
$L = array();
$fail = 0;
function chk(&$L,&$fail,$cond,$label){ $L[] = ($cond?'PASS ':'FAIL ').$label; if(!$cond){$fail++;} }

$L[] = 'WP=' . get_bloginfo('version') . '  WC=' . ( defined('WC_VERSION') ? WC_VERSION : 'MISSING' ) . '  PHP=' . PHP_VERSION;

update_option('woocommerce_currency','LKR');
update_option('woocommerce_ceypay_settings', array('enabled'=>'yes','testmode'=>'no','merchant_id'=>'test-merchant-0001','show_branding'=>'no'));

// --- Gateway registration ---
$gateways = WC()->payment_gateways()->payment_gateways();
chk($L,$fail, isset($gateways['ceypay']), 'gateway registered');
$gw = isset($gateways['ceypay']) ? $gateways['ceypay'] : null;
chk($L,$fail, $gw && $gw->is_available(), 'gateway available at checkout');
chk($L,$fail, $gw && ! $gw->needs_setup(), 'gateway configured (merchant id set)');

// CEYPAY_API_URL is a local-dev override for the mock server. It must never
// take effect on a live store: this blueprint defines it while test mode is
// OFF, so the endpoint has to remain production.
chk($L,$fail, defined('CEYPAY_API_URL'), 'CEYPAY_API_URL defined for this check');
chk($L,$fail, $gw && 'https://api.ceypay.io/' === $gw->api_url, 'api url override ignored in live mode (got ' . ( $gw ? $gw->api_url : 'n/a' ) . ')');

// --- Analytics must be absent from the WordPress.org build ---
chk($L,$fail, ! class_exists('CeyPay_Analytics'), 'analytics class absent');
chk($L,$fail, function_exists('ceypay_has_analytics') && ! ceypay_has_analytics(), 'ceypay_has_analytics() === false');
chk($L,$fail, ! defined('CEYPAY_GA4_MEASUREMENT_ID'), 'GA4 measurement id undefined');
chk($L,$fail, ! defined('CEYPAY_GA4_API_SECRET'), 'GA4 api secret undefined');
if ($gw) { $gw->init_form_fields(); chk($L,$fail, ! isset($gw->form_fields['enable_analytics']), 'analytics setting not offered'); }

// --- Regression guard: the checkout script must still enqueue even though
// --- 'ceypay-analytics' was removed from its dependency array. An unmet
// --- dependency would silently prevent the checkout modal from loading.
if ($gw) {
  wp_scripts();
  $gw->enqueue_checkout_styles();
  global $wp_scripts;
  chk($L,$fail, ! isset($wp_scripts->registered['ceypay-analytics']), 'analytics script not registered');

  // Asset URLs must be normalised. A '../' segment survives into the
  // registered src but is collapsed by the browser, so WooCommerce's
  // dependency detection cannot match the script and warns that it is
  // unregistered.
  $unnormalised = array();
  foreach ( $wp_scripts->registered as $h => $s ) {
    if ( strpos($h,'ceypay') === 0 && ! empty($s->src) && strpos($s->src,'/../') !== false ) { $unnormalised[] = $h; }
  }
  chk($L,$fail, empty($unnormalised), 'script URLs normalised' . ( $unnormalised ? ' (bad: '.implode(',',$unnormalised).')' : '' ));
}

// --- Regression guard: declaring get_setting() private is a PHP fatal,
// --- because AbstractPaymentMethodType declares it protected. Constructing
// --- the class is what catches it.
$blocks_ok = false;
if ( class_exists('Automattic\\WooCommerce\\Blocks\\Payments\\Integrations\\AbstractPaymentMethodType') ) {
  require_once '/wordpress/wp-content/plugins/ceypay-payment-gateway/includes/class-wc-gateway-ceypay-blocks-support.php';
  try {
    $b = new WC_Gateway_CeyPay_Blocks_Support();
    $b->initialize();
    $d = $b->get_payment_method_data();
    $blocks_ok = is_array($d) && isset($d['icons']);
    // Every provider the block renders a chip for needs an icon URL, and every
    // icon URL needs a file behind it. A missing key renders a broken image.
    $need = array('binance','bybit','kucoin','bitazza','ton','solana');
    $missing = array();
    foreach ( $need as $k ) { if ( empty($d['icons'][$k]) ) { $missing[] = $k; } }
    chk($L,$fail, empty($missing), 'blocks icons cover every rendered provider' . ( $missing ? ' (missing: '.implode(',',$missing).')' : '' ));

    $broken = array();
    foreach ( $d['icons'] as $k => $url ) {
      $rel = substr($url, strpos($url,'/assets/'));
      if ( ! file_exists('/wordpress/wp-content/plugins/ceypay-payment-gateway'.$rel) ) { $broken[] = $k; }
    }
    chk($L,$fail, empty($broken), 'every blocks icon file exists' . ( $broken ? ' (broken: '.implode(',',$broken).')' : '' ));
  } catch (\Throwable $e) { $L[] = 'FAIL blocks threw: ' . $e->getMessage(); $fail++; }
}
chk($L,$fail, $blocks_ok, 'blocks payment method data built');

file_put_contents($out, implode("\n", $L) . "\nSTATUS=" . ($fail===0?'ALL_PASS':"FAILURES_$fail") . "\n");
